name: How far in advance should I book a general contractor for an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book a general contractor for an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to book a general contractor for an interior remodel several weeks to a few months in advance, especially for larger projects or during peak construction seasons. This allows ample time for initial consultations, detailed planning, material selection, bid preparation, and securing necessary permits. Reputable contractors often have busy schedules, so early booking ensures you can secure your preferred team and begin your project within your desired timeframe.
